Intentional accounting (no double-counting) but confusing in the UI — consider adding a tooltip 'Bundled, see Bundle card' on Invoice/Tax/PM cards when bundle_subs == subs.

issues: Invoice/Tax/PM cards show MRR €0.00 / STD-PRO 0/0 because both pros are bundle subscribers. Adoption % shows 100% but tier counts show 0/0 — visually inconsistent. Consider showing 'bundled' badge or zero-suppress these cards.

Admin Toolkits MRR allocation logic at admin_advanced_routes L180-205 prefers bundle accounting (if all 3 flags set, attributes MRR to bundle only). This is correct revenue accounting but the frontend should signal this to the operator on the Invoice/Tax/PM cards.
